title: factory.requirement_drafts.diagrams
description: Shape of the requirement_drafts.diagrams jsonb column: one entry per draw.io diagram written alongside a requirement draft's requirements.md, in its doc_dir (see requirement_drafts.doc_dir). The XML itself is not stored here -- it lives on disk at <doc_dir>/<file>.

name.description: Diagram name, shared with the requirements.md reference (![name](name.drawio)) and the file name without its extension.
